arxiv-1905-08182.title: Some properties of geodesic ( α , E ) (\alpha,E) -preinvex functions on a Riemannian manifold
arxiv-1905-08182.creator: Absos Ali Shaikh 1 , Chandan Kumar Mondal 2 , Ravi P Agarwal 3
arxiv-1905-08182.description: Abstract . In this article, we have introduced the concept of geodesic ( α , E ) (\alpha,E) -invex set and by using this concept the notion of geodesic ( α , E ) (\alpha,E) -preinvex functions and geodesic ( α , E ) (\alpha,E) -invex functions are developed on a Riemannian manifold.

arxiv-2109-00837.title: Survey about social engineering and the Varni na internetu awareness campaign, 2020 arXiv
arxiv-2109-00837.creator: Simon Vrhovec
arxiv-2109-00837.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Simon Vrhovec. This paper reports on a study aiming to explore factors associated with behavioral intention to follow a social engineering awareness campaign. The objectives of this study were to determine how perceived severity, perceived vulnerability, perceived threat, fear, subjective norm, attitude towards behavior, perceived behavioral control, self-efficacy, response efficacy, trust in authorities, perceived regulation, authorities performance, information sensitivity and privacy concern are associated with individuals’ behavioral intention to follow a social engineering awareness campaign. The study employed a cross-sectional research design.

arxiv-2110-08660.title: Formation of multiple flocks in a simple nonlocal aggregation model Thanks: This work was supported in part by NSERC Discovery Grant #311685
arxiv-2110-08660.creator: Carrie Clark
arxiv-2110-08660.description: Abstract . We consider a family of interaction energies given by kernels having a “well-barrier” shape, and investigate how these kernels drive the formation of multiple flocks within a larger population. We show that the energy is minimized by a sequence of indicators of finitely many balls whose supports become infinitely far apart from one another.

arxiv-2111-03592.title: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization to understand Spatio-Temporal Traffic Pattern Variations during COVID-19: A Case Study Thanks: This research was supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea (Grant No. 2020R1A2C1012196), and in part by the School of Computer Science and Engineering, Minist
arxiv-2111-03592.creator: Anandkumar Balasubramaniam, Thirunavukarasu Balasubramaniam, Rathinaraja Jeyaraj, Anand Paul, Richi Nayak
arxiv-2111-03592.description: Abstract Due to the rapid developments in Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) and increasing trend in the number of vehicles on road, abundant of road traffic data is generated and available. Understanding spatio-temporal traffic patterns from this data is crucial and has been effectively helping in traffic plannings, road constructions, etc.

arxiv-2303-10223.title: Hessenberg–Toeplitz Matrix Determinants with Schröder and Fine Number Entries
arxiv-2303-10223.description: Abstract In this paper, we find determinant formulas of several Hessenberg–Toeplitz matrices whose nonzero entries are derived from the small and large Schröder and Fine number sequences. Algebraic proofs of these results can be given which make use of Trudi’s formula and the generating function of the associated sequence of determinants.

arxiv-2303-11075.title: Kreisel’s counter-example to full abstraction of the set-theoretical model of Gödel’s system T T
arxiv-2303-11075.creator: Martín Escardó
arxiv-2303-11075.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by Martín Escardó. I have written this note because it doesn’t seem to be well known that
the set-theoretical model of Gödel’s system
T
fails to be fully
abstract. By the context lemma, full abstraction is equivalent to the
statement that the substructure of definable elements is extensional;
that is, that any two definable functionals that agree on definable
arguments must agree on all arguments. Kreisel gave a counter-example
to this, reported in
[
1

by
Barendregt.

arxiv-2411-10081.title: Influence of Depth Camera Noise Models on Respiration Estimation
arxiv-2411-10081.creator: Maurice ROHR \affiliationmark 1, Sebastian DILL \affiliationmark 1
arxiv-2411-10081.description: Abstract Depth cameras are an interesting modality for capturing vital signs such as respiratory rate. Plenty approaches exist to extract vital signs in a controlled setting, but in order to apply them more flexibly for example in multi-camera settings, a simulated environment is needed to generate enough data for training and testing of new algorithms.

arxiv-2411-19415.title: AMO Sampler: Enhancing Text Rendering with Overshooting
arxiv-2411-19415.creator: Xixi Hu, Keyang Xu, Bo Liu, Qiang Liu, Hongliang Fei
arxiv-2411-19415.description: Abstract Achieving precise alignment between textual instructions and generated images in text-to-image generation is a significant challenge, particularly in rendering written text within images. Sate-of-the-art models like Stable Diffusion 3 (SD3), Flux, and AuraFlow still struggle with accurate text depiction, resulting in misspelled or inconsistent text.

arxiv-2505-13994.title: Divide by Question, Conquer by Agent: SPLIT-RAG with Question-Driven Graph Partitioning
arxiv-2505-13994.creator: Ruiyi Yang, Hao Xue, Imran Razzak, Shirui Pan, Hakim Hacid, Flora D. Salim
arxiv-2505-13994.description: Abstract Retrieval-augmented generation over knowledge graphs (KGs) can improve the factual grounding of large language models, but efficient retrieval remains challenging when the underlying graph is large and multi-hop evidence is distributed across different regions. We present SPLIT-RAG , an efficiency-oriented multi-agent KG-RAG framework that organises a KG into reusable, question-aligned partitions using reasoning patterns observed in training questions.

arxiv-2510-06389.title: Mereological Quantum Phase Transitions
arxiv-2510-06389.creator: Paolo Zanardi, Emanuel Dallas, Faidon Andreadakis
arxiv-2510-06389.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Paolo Zanardi, Emanuel Dallas, Faidon Andreadakis. We introduce the novel concept of mereological quantum phase transitions (m-QPTs). Our framework is based on a variational family of operator algebras defining generalized tensor product structures (g-TPS), a parameter-dependent Hamiltonian, and a quantum scrambling functional. By minimizing the scrambling functional, one selects a g-TPS, enabling a pullback of the natural information-geometric metric on the g-TPS manifold to the parameter space.

arxiv-2601-19915.title: Modeling Next-Token Prediction as Left-Nested Intuitionistic Implication
arxiv-2601-19915.creator: PAUL TARAU
arxiv-2601-19915.description: Abstract We introduce the Arrow Language Model , a neural architecture derived from an intuitionistic-logic interpretation of next-token prediction. Instead of representing tokens as additive embeddings mixed by attention, we encode a prefix as a left-nested implication chain whose structure preserves order through non-commutative composition.

pmc-10696793.title: Breast cancer survival after mammography dissemination in Brazil: a population-based analysis of 2,715 cases
pmc-10696793.creator: Juliana O. Fernandes, Beatriz F. Machado, Cassio Cardoso-Filho, Juliana Nativio, Cesar Cabello, Diama B. Vale
pmc-10696793.description: BackgroundThis study aims to assess breast cancer survival rates after one decade of mammography in a large urban area of Brazil.MethodsIt is a population-based retrospective cohort of women with breast cancer in Campinas, São Paulo, from 2010 to 2014. Age, vital status and stage were accessed through the cancer and mortality registry, and patients records.

pmc-11644247.title: Unraveling Quinoa (Chenopodium quinoa Willd.) Defense Against Downy Mildew (Peronospora variabilis): Comparative Molecular Analysis of Resistant “Hualhuas” and Susceptible “Real” Cultivars
pmc-11644247.creator: Walaa Khalifa, Hala Badr Khalil, Marian Thabet
pmc-11644247.description: Quinoa (Chenopodium quinoa Willd.) is a new, promising non-conventional useful crop; however, its susceptibility to downy mildew, caused by Peronospora variabilis, is a key obstacle limiting its productivity in Egypt. Identifying and utilizing resistant quinoa cultivars appear to be reliable and cost-efficient strategies for controlling downy mildew, particularly in resource-limited farmers’ fields.

pmc-12579825.title: METTL3/IGF2BP2-Mediated m6A RNA Methylation Drives Alveolar Macrophage-Dependent Neutrophil Recruitment in Cigarette Smoke-Induced COPD
pmc-12579825.creator: Andi Lin, Jian Wang, Lixing Wang, Yaping Zhang
pmc-12579825.description: IntroductionChronic inflammatory infiltration caused by cigarette smoke is one of the primary characteristics that define chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), but the epigenetic mechanisms governing immune cell crosstalk remain poorly defined. This study aims to elucidate the critical role of m6A RNA methylation in modulating alveolar macrophage-neutrophil interactions during COPD progression.

pmc-12623298.title: Oral and Skin Sensitisation to Peanut Show Different Immunological Features in Brown Norway Rats
pmc-12623298.creator: Tiffany K. S. Sztuk, Jeppe M. Larsen, Neil M. Rigby, Anne‐Sofie R. Ballegaard, Irina Pozdnyakova, Stef J. Koppelman, Alan R. Mackie, Katrine L. Bøgh
pmc-12623298.description: Food allergy may develop after both oral and skin exposure to food allergens. Identifying immunological features associated with the sensitisation route is important for understanding the extent to which patients are sensitised through the oral or skin route and may be required to improve food allergy immunotherapy.

pmc-13279371.title: Association between a Periconception Healthy Plant-Based Diet and Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes
pmc-13279371.creator: McKenzie K Jancsura, William A Grobman, Jiqiang Wu, Hanna M Griffis, Michael D Wirth, David M Haas, Robert M Silver, Maisa N Feghali, Uma M Reddy, Lisa Levine, George Saade, Lynn M Yee, Karen L Lindsay, Kartik K Venkatesh
pmc-13279371.description: BackgroundPlant-based diets are increasingly popular and may improve cardiometabolic health, but their association with adverse pregnancy outcomes (APOs) is unclear, and dietary patterns are influenced by food access.ObjectivesWe investigated whether adherence to plant-based dietary patterns was associated with APOs and whether the association varied by neighborhood food access.

pmc-13300394.title: Matched cohort comparison between endo epicardial and lattice tip catheter ablation for non paroxysmal atrial fibrillation utilising a standardised left atrial lesion set
pmc-13300394.creator: K Manoharan, J U S T O Julia Calvo, J A M E S Mccready, J A G A N Muthurajah, J O H N Silberbauer, I A N Mann
pmc-13300394.description: BackgroundDespite recent advances, catheter ablation for persistent atrial fibrillation remains limited in efficacy. Catheter-based linear lesion sets have not consistently shown benefit, largely owing to insufficient transmurality with endocardial radiofrequency. An endo-epicardial ablation strategy has been associated with higher acute block rates, and the lattice-tip catheter has reported to achieve greater lesion depth and more durable endocardial linear block.
